messages.en:
{07 14 00}This is the week of the
{ff 00 00 03}Bright Nights {ff 00 00 00}celebration,
{04 1f 00}.

{07 14 00}It's cold out, but I like it.
The cold makes everything
feel crisp and clean.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Väljas on külm, aga mulle
meeldib. Külm teeb kõik
kargeks ja puhtaks.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I feel so wonderful.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Maybe
it's the snow. {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0e 00}Or maybe I'm
delirious from the cold.
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mul on nii hea tunne.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Ehk
on see lumi. {01 00 00 0a 00}{07 0e 00}Või ehk olen
ma külmast segaduses.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Heya, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Today's
the start of {ff 00 00 03}Bright Nights{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
I worked my hinder off to
get my decorations up, so I
really hope my house wins.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Tsau, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0a 00} Täna
algavad {ff 00 00 03}valgusööd{ff 00 00 00},
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
Ma nägin kurja vaeva oma
kaunistustega, nii et
loodan, et mu maja võidab.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Have you seen all the lights
on my house? I just
finished decorating.
{07 14 00}What with {ff 00 00 03}Bright Nights{ff 00 00 00}
starting today, I had to be
sure my house looked good!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kas sa oled näinud kõiki
tulesid mu majal? Ma just
sain kaunistamise valmis.
{07 14 00}Kuna {ff 00 00 03}valgusööd{ff 00 00 00} algavad
täna, pidin ma hoolitsema,
et mu maja hea välja näeks!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So, had a chance to check
out my decorations this
year, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
If you liked my house, {07 0b 00}
would you go let {ff 00 00 06}Tortimer
{ff 00 00 00}know? I'd appreciate it.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nii, kas said sel aastal
mu kaunistusi
vaadata, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
Kui mu maja meeldis, {07 0b 00}
kas annaksid {ff 00 00 06}Tortimerile
{ff 00 00 00}teada? Oleksin tänulik.

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So, tell me honestly,
{04 1f 00}, what do you
think of my decorations?
No, wait! Better yet, don't
tell me!{01 00 00 05 00} Tell {ff 00 00 06}Tortimer{ff 00 00 00}!

{07 14 00}I think he'd like to know
just how fabulous my house
looks!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ütle mulle ausalt,
{04 1f 00}, mida sa arvad
minu kaunistustest?
Ei, oota! Veel parem, ära
ütle mulle!{01 00 00 05 00} Ütle {ff 00 00 06}Tortimerile{ff 00 00 00}!

{07 14 00}Ma arvan, et ta tahaks
teada, kui vapustav mu
maja välja näeb!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Have you seen my house? I
spent a lot of time putting
up those decorations{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 16 00}You don't think it's too
much, do you?{01 00 00 05 00} I don't want
to be THAT person...
{07 06 00}You know, the one with the
super gaudy lights everyone
secretly laughs at?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Kas sa nägid mu maja?
Ma kulutasin palju aega
nende kaunistuste peale{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.
{07 16 00}Sa ei arva ju, et seda on
liiga palju?{01 00 00 05 00} Ma ei taha
olla SEE inimene...
{07 06 00}Tead küll, see, kelle üle-
kuhjatud tulede üle kõik
salaja naeravad?

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Oh, heya, {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} So,
have you heard who won
the {ff 00 00 03}Bright Nights{ff 00 00 00} award?
{07 16 00}Well, if you couldn't guess,
it wasn't me. AGAIN. For,
like, the hundredth time!
{07 0f 00}I guess it was just too
much. I thought it looked
pretty, but I guess not.
{07 00 00}{ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} was declared
the {ff 00 00 02}Bright Star{ff 00 00 00} for that
halfhearted effort.
{07 06 00}I mean, look at it! It's so...
nothing! If you're going to
decorate, go all the way!
{07 16 00}Don't just toss a few lights
up there!{01 01 00} {07 06 00}What's festive
about that, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Oh, tsau, {04 1f 00}.{01 00 00 0a 00} Nii,
kas sa kuulsid, kes võitis
{ff 00 00 03}valgusööde{ff 00 00 00} auhinna?
{07 16 00}Noh, kui sa ei arvanud ära,
siis mitte mina. JÄLLE.
Vist juba sajandat korda!
{07 0f 00}Vist oli seda lihtsalt
liiga palju. Ma arvasin, et
oli ilus, aga vist mitte.
{07 00 00}{ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} kuulutati
{ff 00 00 02}säratäheks{ff 00 00 00} selle
leige pingutuse eest.
{07 06 00}Vaata seda! See on nii...
tühjus! Kui kaunistad,
siis tee seda lõpuni!
{07 16 00}Ära lihtsalt viska paari
tuld üles!{01 01 00} {07 06 00}Mis on selles
pidulikku, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?!

messages.en:
{07 16 00}Didn't you like the lights I
put up around my house?
Didn't you tell {ff 00 00 06}Tortimer{ff 00 00 00}?
{07 0f 00}Because {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} won!
And I thought I had a good
chance this year!
{07 16 00}I'm just sad that I lost.


{07 00 00}I mean, {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} did do
a great job decorating, so
I shouldn't complain.
{07 1a 00}In fact, I really should be
big about this and go
congratulate {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}.
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Kas sulle ei meeldinud mu
tuled maja ümber? Kas sa
ei öelnud {ff 00 00 06}Tortimerile{ff 00 00 00}?
{07 0f 00}Sest {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} võitis!
Ja mina arvasin, et mul on
sel aastal hea võimalus!
{07 16 00}Mul on lihtsalt kurb, et
kaotasin.

{07 00 00}Ma mõtlen, {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} tegi
kaunistamisel head tööd,
nii et ma ei nurise.
{07 1a 00}Tegelikult peaksin ma olema
suuremeelne ja minema
{ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00} õnnitlema.

messages.en:
{07 16 00}I have some sad news.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} I'm
not even sure how to tell
you this, {04 02 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}I guess I should just come
out and say it. {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 0f 00}I didn't
make the cut!
{07 00 00}I lost the Bright Star title
to {ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}.{01 01 00}
{07 08 00}I'm so jealous, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
messages.et:
{07 16 00}Mul on kurbi uudiseid.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Ma
ei tea isegi, kuidas sulle
seda öelda, {04 02 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}
{07 00 00}Ma vist ütlen lihtsalt
välja. {01 00 00 0f 00}{07 0f 00}Ma ei pääsenud
edasi!
{07 00 00}Ma kaotasin säratähe tiitli
{ff 00 00 06}{04 0f 00}{ff 00 00 00}-le.{01 01 00}
{07 08 00}Ma olen nii kade, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!

messages.en:
{07 0d 00}I can't believe it! This is
the best {ff 00 00 03}Bright Nights{ff 00 00 00}
ever, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!
{07 14 00}That's right! You're looking
at this year's winner for
stellar house decoration!
{07 0d 00}That makes me the {ff 00 00 02}Bright
Star{ff 00 00 00}! {01 00 00 05 00}And that makes the
rest of you losers! Ha!
messages.et:
{07 0d 00}Ma ei suuda uskuda! Need on
parimad {ff 00 00 03}valgusööd{ff 00 00 00}
üldse, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 1f 00}!
{07 14 00}Just nii! Sa vaatad selle
aasta võitjat maja-
kaunistamises!
{07 0d 00}See teeb minust {ff 00 00 02}sära-
tähe{ff 00 00 00}! {01 00 00 05 00}Ja teist kõigist
kaotajad! Hah!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}I did do a nice job with my
lighting this year, don't
you think, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}It just goes to show what
can happen if you put your
heart into it.
{07 0d 00}I feel like I can take on
the world right now!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ma tegin sel aastal oma
valgustusega head tööd, kas
sa ei arva, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 14 00}See näitab, mis võib
juhtuda, kui sa paned
sellesse oma südame.
{07 0d 00}Ma tunnen, et võin praegu
kogu maailma vallutada!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So tell me, what did you
like best about my {ff 00 00 03}Bright
Nights{ff 00 00 00} lights this year?
{07 14 00}Tee hee.{01 00 00 05 00} I'm just kidding. I
know you loved everything
about it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}After all, weren't you the
one who told {ff 00 00 06}Tortimer{ff 00 00 00} how
great my house looked?
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ütle mulle, mis sulle kõige
rohkem meeldis mu selle
aasta {ff 00 00 03}valgusööde{ff 00 00 00} tuledes?
{07 14 00}Hi hii.{01 00 00 05 00} Ma ainult naljatan.
Ma tean, et sulle meeldis
kõik, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
{07 00 00}Lõppude lõpuks olid sa ju
see, kes {ff 00 00 06}Tortimerile{ff 00 00 00} ütles,
kui hea mu maja välja nägi?

messages.en:
{07 14 00}I'm so glad that you liked
my lights, {04 1f 00}!
I worked hard on them.
{07 00 00}Once {ff 00 00 03}Bright Nights{ff 00 00 00} is over,
all the decorations will
come down, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}But I'll always have the
memory of how special
this year was!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Mul on nii hea meel, et
sulle mu tuled meeldisid,
{04 1f 00}! Ma nägin vaeva.
{07 00 00}Kui {ff 00 00 03}valgusööd{ff 00 00 00} läbi saavad,
võetakse kõik kaunistused
maha, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
{07 14 00}Aga mul jääb alatiseks
mälestus sellest, kui
eriline see aasta oli!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So tell me the truth...
Were {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}'s really
that good, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 16 00}I'm just curious! I swear
I'm not going to rip off
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00}'s design!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ütle mulle ausalt...
Kas {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} omad olid
tõesti nii head, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 16 00}Puhas uudishimu! Vannun,
et ma ei varasta
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} disaini!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}So, what, you're telling me
you prefer something like
what {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} put up?
{07 0e 00}Because, seriously, that
place was about as festive
as a tombstone.
{07 14 00}But that does tell me what
sort of thing you're looking
for in your holiday decor!
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Nii et sa ütled mulle, et
sulle meeldib rohkem
midagi {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} moodi?
{07 0e 00}Sest tõsiselt, see koht oli
umbes sama pidulik
kui hauakivi.
{07 14 00}Aga see ütleb mulle, mida
sa oma pühadekaunistustelt
otsid!

messages.en:
{07 00 00}Honestly, I've never seen
{ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} put that much
effort into ANYTHING.
But I guess it paid off. I
mean, my house sure didn't
win anything this year.
{07 16 00}I guess I'll just have to
add even more lights next
year, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 00 00}Ausalt, ma pole kunagi
näinud, et {ff 00 00 06}{04 10 00}{ff 00 00 00} oleks
MILLEGI nimel pingutanud.
Aga vist tasus ära. Minu
maja küll sel aastal
midagi ei võitnud.
{07 16 00}Ma vist pean järgmisel
aastal veel rohkem tulesid
lisama, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.

messages.en:
{07 14 00}Well, this is it... The last
day of {ff 00 00 03}Bright Nights{ff 00 00 00}.

{07 0d 00}I can't wait to find out
whose house will win the
{ff 00 00 02}Bright Star{ff 00 00 00} this year!
messages.et:
{07 14 00}Noh, nii see on... Viimane
{ff 00 00 03}valgusööde{ff 00 00 00} päev.

{07 0d 00}Ma ei jõua oodata, kelle
maja võidab sel aastal
{ff 00 00 02}säratähe{ff 00 00 00}!

messages.en:
{07 19 00}I can't pick a favorite
house{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} There are so many
good ones this year!
{07 14 00}I mean, you can really tell
that everyone put their all
into it, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
messages.et:
{07 19 00}Ma ei oska lemmikmaja
valida{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00}.{01 00 00 05 00} Sel aastal on
nii palju häid!
{07 14 00}Ma mõtlen, on tõesti näha,
et kõik panid sellesse
kogu oma hinge, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}.
